primary_maintainer_review.scope: A7 IV6.02; author-reported persisted shutter-angle display and shared implementation research. LUT menu and recording routes remain gated/unproven in the reviewed status.
A6000 author-reported Darwin firmware modification on an older CRC-based update path, not a classic FX3 signature-admission implementation.
Reviewed recovery report remains open; post-update failure is identified as user testimony, with cause and independent recovery unproven. No conclusion about FX3 failure behavior is inferred.

Current public format selector retrieved as text and inspected, not executed. Dedicated VENICE DATA23213/type3/type4 decoding not obtained. This does not prove no such implementation exists elsewhere.
